titles.native: 生きぬけ！爆走！クソハムちゃん

description:
The anime's release celebrates the character's "birthday" as a stamp character for the LINE messaging service. The character is a hamster that came from space.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: All 24 episodes were first available for free in the Manga ONE app and on the official Kusohamu-chan YouTube channel for 24 hours.
